coder_notes: Hepatocellular carcinoma trial; glioblastoma is not named anywhere except in the bevacizumab intervention description, so excluded at S5 (not_glioblastoma). Agents coded for completeness. TACE is registered as a combination product with no named chemotherapy drug, so it is not listed as an agent. Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy (D6) but here is investigational in HCC; coded experimental_combination with atezolizumab. Treatment setting refers to treatment-naive BCLC B HCC.
